hero.title: No more arguments over month-end accounts.
hero.description: Record daily meals, deposits and market expenses. Mess Mate automatically organizes the meal rate and every member's balance.

features.title: No separate ledgers. Your whole mess in one system.
features.description: Mess Mate is designed around the real accounting needs of messes, hostels and shared living in Bangladesh—essentials up front, complexity behind the scenes.

mealEntry.title: Daily meal entry
mealEntry.description: Update everyone's daily meal count from one fast, uncluttered grid.

deposits.title: Deposit tracking
deposits.description: Record member deposits with dates and see who paid what without searching a ledger.

expenses.title: Market and other expenses
expenses.description: Keep everything from groceries to gas bills together, complete with categories and notes.

balance.title: Automatic meal rate and balances
balance.description: Calculate the meal rate from expenses and meals, then show each member's payable or receivable balance.

members.title: Online and offline members
members.description: Manage every member in the same account, whether or not they have an app account, and assign roles as needed.

periods.title: Month-based accounting

roles.title: Role-based control
roles.description: Give owners, managers and members access based on responsibility, keeping important actions in the right hands.

summary.title: Summary at a glance

step3.description: Quickly update meals, deposits and expenses—and correct mistakes when needed.

faq.title: Common questions worth answering.
faq.description: The things mess managers usually want to know before getting started.

item1.question: Can I add a member who has no account?
item1.answer: Yes. Add them by name as an offline member. Their meals, deposits, expense share and monthly balance are calculated just like everyone else's.

item2.question: How is the meal rate calculated?
item2.answer: Shared meal expenses for the current period are divided by total meals. The summary updates whenever a meal or expense is added.

item3.question: Do owners, managers and members get the same access?
item3.answer: No. Owners manage the workspace, managers handle daily operations, and members see the accounts they need.

item4.question: Are accounts kept separately for each month?
item4.answer: Yes. Every month is a separate period, keeping current activity and previous history neatly organized.

item5.question: Can I use it from a phone?
item5.answer: Absolutely. From the homepage to the dashboard, the interface is responsive and designed for small screens and touch.

cta.title: Make next month's accounts easier.
cta.description: Create a workspace today, add members and start daily entries. By month end, the accounts will be clear—with fewer unnecessary arguments, in sha Allah.

footer.description: A platform that simplifies meal and monthly accounting for messes, hostels and shared living.
